Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL4426. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value not null. Require canonical SMILES via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
